instruction: The init file is located at C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc. You need to import it via Revit's "Open IFC" feature (File > Open > IFC) before doing the task. Two Storey Meeting Center Retrofit IFC This task starts from init.ifc and uses the local reference image init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into a two-storey meeting center scheme and export the completed model as result.ifc in the Desktop. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc, and result.ifc is at least 500 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 2 IfcBuildingStorey entities, 5 IfcSpace entities, 12 IfcWall entities, 3 IfcSlab entities, and 5 IfcCurtainWall entities. 5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcColumn, 0 IfcBeam, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. 6. After replacing hyphens and underscores with spaces and lowercasing names, the IfcSpace name list contains the token lobby at least once and meeting at least 4 times. 7. After the same normalization, the IfcSpace name list contains the exact space name central lobby at least once. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
